sources.finding: The iPhone app policy, last updated 2026-10-30, says the app sends crash and error reports to Sentry (error, code location, app version, phone model, iOS version; host addresses removed), uses no analytics, and that users turn reports off in Settings > Privacy > Send crash reports.
